title: Context Graph: Explainable Multi-Agent Decision Chains in AI-RAN
abstract: arXiv:2611.16879v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI-RAN distributes network control across multiple autonomous agents, namely xApps and rApps operating over shared radio resources. When an alert or degradation appears, operators currently lack a structured way to trace which decision caused it, what context triggered that decision, and how other agents interacted. Existing explainability tools focus on single-model feature attribution or linear event logging, neither of which captures cross-agent decision chains. We propose the Context Graph, a heterogeneous directed graph that organizes policies, measurements, decisions, and alerts into a queryable explanation layer. Its foundational primitive is the Decision-Event node acting as a causal junction, where incoming edges capture triggering context and outgoing edges track downstream consequences that are progressively upgraded through counterfactual verification. translated_title: 上下文图：AI-RAN中可解释的多智能体决策链
translated_abstract: AI-RAN（AI无线接入网）将网络控制分布于多个自治智能体上，即在共享无线资源上运行的xApps和rApps。当出现警报或性能退化时，运营商目前缺乏一种结构化方式来追溯是哪个决策导致了问题、什么上下文触发了该决策，以及其他智能体之间是如何交互的。现有的可解释性工具专注于单模型的特征归因或线性事件日志记录，两者都无法捕捉跨智能体的决策链。我们提出了上下文图，这是一种异构有向图，将策略、测量、决策和警报组织成一个可查询的解释层。其基础原语是“决策-事件”节点，充当因果连接点：入边捕捉触发的上下文，出边追踪下游后果，而这些后果会通过反事实验证被逐步确认。基于现有的E2、A1和O1数据流进行实例化，我们的概念验证……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 本文提出“上下文图”这一异构有向图方法，以“决策-事件”节点为因果连接原语，将AI-RAN中多个智能体的策略、测量、决策与警报组织成可查询的解释层，从而实现对跨智能体决策链的可追溯与可解释分析。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Context Graph, a heterogeneous directed graph built on Decision-Event nodes that organizes policies, measurements, decisions, and alerts into a queryable causal explanation layer, enabling traceable and explainable cross-agent decision chains in AI-RAN.
